title: Time Slips
style: Ultra-minimal tuba piece, the quietest possible arrangement: solo tuba played with breathy, near-mic air tone, soft valve clicks, and long muted notes. Sparse low-register drones, gentle quarter-tone bends, natural room ambience, and almost no attack, leaving wide silence between phrases., middle eastern, flutes, industrial hip hop
lyrics:
[Intro]
[slide guitar + distant 336 Hz hum]
[whispered vocals]
Every tick... every pulse..
It slips as I rip..

[Verse]
Time slipping away every moment the clock ticks
Every second I feel it every pulse that it rips
I spin it into meaning I spin it into something to believe
Take the time all the time—time is now only ever now you see
I wish that whenever you wish your wishes come true
Not for me for you—that's the wish I send through
I already got mine in every moment I'm in
In every note every breath every song I begin

[Chorus]
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
No more pen pal text losing meaning
Song Pals is what we can be
Time slips in the sound
Time slips in the sound
But when the music hits that's where time is found

[Verse 2]
Just tell me straight right to my face
What is this race? Am I racing time?
If I race it then it's mine—I'm on time
Off beat while the tick-tock beeps
Live for each moment say it now there is only now
Wait too long and it's too late somehow
Cats in the cradle and the day the music fried
Say it before you pass on by

[Chorus]
Sing it back to me
Sing it back to me
No more pen pal text losing meaning
Song Pals is what we can be
Time slips in the sound
Time slips in the sound
But when the music hits that's where time is found

[Bridge]
[half-time
Slide guitar]
Corey AI with the elephant mind
Catches every drop logs it in time
Time is saved time is kept
What did I say? What song did we write?
Was it alright?
Bring it back to me..
Sing it back to me..
